data.name: Miskeenat
data.gender_notes: Miskeenat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Miskeenat is an Arabic name for a female, derived from the Arabic word 'Miskin' meaning poor or needy. This name is often given to a baby girl as a reminder of the importance of compassion and humility towards those in need. The name Miskeenat carries the meaning “The Poor One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Miskeenat usually hope their child will grow to embody the poor one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Miskeenat represents the spiritual trait of humility and compassion towards the less fortunate in society. It is a reminder that no matter how wealthy or successful one becomes, it is important to always remember the plight of the poor and to offer help and support where possible.
data.etymology: Miskeenat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Poor One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Miskeenat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_english.name: Miskeenat
in_english.long_meaning: Miskeenat is a feminine Arabic name derived from the root 's-k-n', which means 'poor' or 'weak'. The term 'Miskeen' is used in the Quran to refer to the poor and needy. As a name, Miskeenat signifies humility, modesty, and compassion. It reflects the values of kindness and charity in Islamic tradition.
